priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Everson's resignation was submitted in a letter, which is attached to the filing as an exhibit, and he did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. Researchers Say Hackers Targeted PHP Before Flaws Were Known
general.summary: Hackers attempted to exploit security vulnerabilities in the widely used programming language PHP several days before the flaws became public, according to cybersecurity researchers at Amazon.com Inc.
